cases.local_answer:
The refund due is **$86.66**. That is 8 unused months of the $129.99 annual membership ($129.99 × 8/12), with no cancellation fee or nonrefundable credit applied.

I can't give the net amount owed yet because the upgrade price isn't in the calculation. If you give me the new membership's price, I'll subtract the refund from it. For example, a $199.99 upgrade would leave $113.33 owed ($199.99 − $86.66).

I also assumed the membership is outside the cooling-off period and that no cancellation fee applies. If either is wrong, tell me and I'll rerun the numbers. No transaction was performed; this is only a calculation.
